content:
[Intro]
[G]
[D/F#]
[Em7]
[C]

[Verse 1]
[G]I met you in the dark
[D/F#]You lit me up
[Em7]You made me feel as though
[C]I was enough
[G]We danced the night away
[D/F#]We drank too much
[Em7]I held your hair back when
[C]You were throwing up
[G]Then you smiled over your shoulder
[D/F#]For a minute I was stonecold sober
[Em7]I pulled you closer to m-
[C]y chest
[G]And you asked me to stay over
[D/F#]I said, I already told you
[Em7]I think that you should get s-
[C]ome rest

[Chorus]
[G]I knew I loved you then
[D/F#]But you'd never know
[Em7]'Cause I played it cool when I was
[C]scared of letting go
[G]I knew I needed you
[D/F#]But I never showed
[Em7]But I wanna stay with you Un-
[C]til we're grey and old Just
[G]say you won't let go
[D/F#]Just
[Em7]say you won't let go
[C]

[Verse 2]
[G]I wake you up with some
[D/F#]Breakfast in bed
[Em7]I'll bring you coffee with
[C]a kiss on your head
[G]And I'll take the kids to school
[D/F#]Wave them goodbye
[Em7]And I'll thank my lucky stars
[C]For that night
[G]When you looked over your shoulder
[D/F#]For a minute I forget that I'm older
[Em7]I wanna dance with you right
[C]now, oh
[G]And you look a beautiful as ever
[D/F#]And I swear that every day you get better
[Em7]You make me feel this way s-
[C]omehow

[Chorus]
[G]I'm so in love with you
[D/F#]And I hope you know
[Em7]Darling, your love is more than
[C]worth its weight in gold
[G]We've come so far, my dear
[D/F#]Look how we've grown
[Em7]And I wanna stay with you Un-
[C]til we're grey and old Just
[G]say you won't let go
[D/F#]Just
[Em7]say you won't let go
[C]
[G]I wanna live with you
[D/F#]Even when we're ghosts
[Em7]'Cause you were always there for me when
[C]I needed you most

[Outro]
[G]I'm gonna love you 'til
[D/F#]My lungs give out
[Em7]I promise 'til death we part
[C]Like in our vows
[G]So I wrote this song for you
[D/F#]Now everybody knows
[Em7]That it's just you and me Un-
[C]til we're grey and old Just
[G]say you won't let go
[D/F#]Just
[Em7]say you won't let go
[C]Just
[G]say you won't let go
[D/F#]Oh, just
[Em7]say you won't let go
[C]
[G]

title: Say you won't let go
tuning: E A D G B E
